purpose: Maximize legitimate non-contact evidence and solution preparation for high-priority marketplace targets without treating public/internal evidence as target-authorized remediation evidence.

precontact_evidence_classes.P1_TARGET_PUBLIC_PRIMARY: Target SEC filings, official releases, public supplier/quality/security pages, public job descriptions and other first-party public evidence.
precontact_evidence_classes.P2_INDEPENDENT_AUTHORITATIVE_PUBLIC: Government, regulator, standards-body, court, procurement, safety/incident, certification or other authoritative independent public records where applicable.
precontact_evidence_classes.P3_REPRODUCIBLE_PUBLIC_ANALOG: Independent public datasets, peer-reviewed benchmarks or reproducible analogs testing the same evidence-control failure mode without pretending to measure the target.
precontact_evidence_classes.P4_APPLICABILITY_AND_BOUNDARY: Public standards/security/export/safety/quality applicability mapping that identifies what would need target-specific confirmation and what cannot be claimed.
precontact_evidence_classes.P5_ROUTE_VERIFICATION: Verification of a lawful official supplier, partnership, small-business, business-development or public intake route without sending a message.

execution_rule: Precontact work may improve preparedness, falsification quality and source coverage but must not change any external gate to verified, exceed the 55% evidence ceiling, or authorize contact. Target-authorized evidence remains mandatory for the 98.7 contact gate.
claims_boundary: This matrix is a research and evidence-acquisition plan. It does not assert that any target has an operational defect beyond the exact public evidence cited elsewhere, that Worldshepherd will remediate it, or that any contact, partnership, eligibility, compliance, safety or commercial outcome is authorized or likely.
